automix.reported_by_owner: Automix did nothing on the device (owner, 2026-11-14, with two screenshots of an album page). It could not be reproduced here: no audio device or emulator is available.
likely_cause_addressed: albums played in order were never mixed (the owner was on an album page): they now are by default, with a setting, except albums whose titles run together with no gap
a single failed attempt gave up the pair for good: the next title is now resolved on the spot and tried again up to three times
preparation started 75 s before the end: it now starts 150 s before, so the next title is loaded long before any mix
no feedback: a status line in the queue and in Settings now says what Automix is doing or exactly why it is not mixing
tested_on_host: tempo, beat positions, bar detection, intro/outro/fade/hard-ending detection and loudness on synthetic audio with known values (BeatAnalysisTest)
the transition planner on hand-built analyses, including albums, gapless albums and the new longer mixes (TransitionPlannerTest)
level curves, the bass hand-over filter and the tempo nudging rule (DeckDspTest); the per-deck processor (DeckMixProcessorTest)
the status line translated in the ten languages, the queue switch and status line, the settings (host tests)
never_run_with_real_audio: the two-deck engine has still not been executed against real audio output on any device or emulator: the silent fast reading of both titles, the incoming deck's start, the tempo lock, the session hand-over
how a mix sounds: no transition was listened to
tempo and beat detection on real music (only synthetic material was analysed)
whether the status line now explains the owner's case: it was built to be read and reported back
safeguards: off by default; any seek, title change, error, missing analysis or lack of time gives up the transition and the title ends as before
if the player's internal clock cannot be confirmed against positions at run time, only a plain crossfade on the decks' volume is used

artist_signatures.cause_found: the artwork service of the app answers 429 'temporarily unavailable' to most artists; the signature archive was only asked after it succeeded, so a 429 lost the signature. A possessive file name ("Eminem's signature") was also refused.
artist_signatures.fix: both services are asked side by side and judged apart; possessives, numbers and notes in brackets are ignored when matching a file to an artist
artist_signatures.checked_live_by_hand: artistsignature.velixir.run answers for Eminem, Juice WRLD, Travis Scott, Booba, Ninho, Daft Punk and Drake and returns 404 for Werenoi, PNL and Stromae; the app was not run on a device
artist_signatures.limits: an artist the archive does not know keeps the plain name; homonyms are refused unless the file is named after the artist alone

owner_section_changes: Album framing: the whole picture is now drawn and moved, so no empty band appears when the rectangle reaches past what the hero shows (reported with two screenshots, 2026-11-14).

Studio Visuals: a Canvas can be switched off (or back on) for a title or an album; for an album, its titles are listed with check boxes and the Canvas can be switched off, restored to the catalogue's own, or replaced for the ticked titles at once (none ticked: the whole album).
Server: POST /admin/override takes up to 80 titles in one request (the file is stored once) and canvasOff; an overridden file is deleted only when no other row still names it.
known_limitations: Owner-section changes are deliberately not mentioned in the public release notes (owner preference).
Automix needs the next title to be playable without a new resolution or one that succeeds in time; otherwise it says so and the title ends as before.
Automix does not mix into titles added by Autoplay at the end of the queue, nor a title whose source was chosen by hand.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
